upstream.description: Turn Windsurf / Devin Desktop's 100+ AI models (Claude, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, Kimi, GLM, SWE) into OpenAI-, Anthropic- & Gemini-compatible APIs. Zero-dependency self-hosted reverse proxy for Claude Code, Cline & Cursor. 把 Windsurf/Devin 云端 100+ 模型变成三套兼容 API。

classification.analysis: WindsurfAPI is a self-hosted, zero-npm-dependency Node.js reverse proxy that turns Windsurf/Devin Desktop's 100+ backend AI models (Claude, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, Kimi, GLM, SWE) into OpenAI-, Anthropic-, and Gemini-compatible API endpoints by translating requests into Windsurf's internal gRPC protocol via its local Language Server binary. It manages an account pool with round-robin rotation, rate-limit isolation, and failover, strips upstream Windsurf identity from responses, and ships a web dashboard, Docker/systemd/launchd deployment scripts, and detailed release/handoff logs. Aimed at developers who want to point Claude Code, Cline, or Cursor at a self-hosted endpoint to access many models through Windsurf/Devin's subscription rather than paying per-provider API costs; the README explicitly frames this as a reverse-engineered, ToS-adjacent proxy.

use_cases.title: Point Claude Code or Cursor at a self-hosted multi-model API gateway
Access 100+ AI models through an OpenAI-compatible endpoint without per-provider keys
Pool and rotate Windsurf/Devin accounts with automatic failover
